pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark regions with moderate edge angularity. Pixel gradients at the boundaries are relatively smooth. Spatial area of patches is largest on the upper flank, significantly decreasing in size and increasing in density toward the posterior and distal regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pelage forming a topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial and tetra-radial. Pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform across the central flank but narrows at the transition to the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dense mane extending along the dorsal ridge. The profile exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background pixels.
